subject.title: fix(security): inherit agents.defaults tools/sandbox for containment

question: For a routable or dynamically resolved agent ID with no `agents.list` entry, should OpenClaw apply the operator-declared `agents.defaults.tools` and `agents.defaults.sandbox` policy as this PR does, or refuse the turn rather than running under a partial default policy?
rationale: The linked security report presents both fail-closed models, and selecting one defines an enduring containment contract for dynamic-agent and enrollment-race paths.

options.title: Apply declared containment defaults
options.body: Adopt this PR’s model: when operators explicitly configure defaults, use them for missing-agent containment while retaining existing non-containment fallbacks.

options.title: Reject unknown-agent turns
options.body: Require an explicit `agents.list` entry before serving a turn, eliminating unknown-agent execution instead of assigning defaults.

recommendation.title: Apply declared containment defaults
recommendation.body: Adopt this PR’s model: when operators explicitly configure defaults, use them for missing-agent containment while retaining existing non-containment fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a shared core containment and configuration-contract decision rather than a localized contributor repair.
